chunks: And Ismaʿīl ibn Muslim al-Sakūnī narrated from Jaʿfar ibn Muḥammad, from his father عليه السلام, from Abū Dharr, may Allah have mercy on him, who said:

I heard the Messenger of Allah صلى الله عليه وآله وسلم say: “When the deceased dies during travel, do not conceal his death from his family, for it is a trust regarding the waiting period of his wife, so that she may observe it, and so that his inheritance may be divided among his family before one of them dies and his share is thereby lost.”

key_terms.أَمَانَةٌ: a trust and responsibility that must be fulfilled
key_terms.تَعْتَدُّ: she observes the legally required waiting period
key_terms.فِي سَفَرٍ: during travel or on a journey
key_terms.لِعِدَّةِ امْرَأَتِهِ: concerning his wife's waiting period after his death

ai.seo_question: Why should a death during travel not be concealed from the deceased person's family?
ai.summary: This hadith instructs that a person's death during travel should not be concealed from the family. It highlights legal and moral consequences of timely notification, especially the wife's ʿiddah and the proper division of inheritance before other heirs die and shares are lost.
